snippet.title: TELETUBBIES - My First App | Teletubbies Love Tubby Custard | Wildbrain Toy Club - Fun For Kids!
snippet.description:
Watch as we play Teletubbies: My First App! Were you able to guess Tinky Winky, Dipsy, La La and Po's favourite things, correctly? 
TAP to SUBSCRIBE ⏩⏩⏩ https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCpaZtD4Lz9dTBkk9_FyAylw?sub_confirmation=1

Come and join Wildbrain Toy Club! It really is as much fun as it looks. We’ll be playing with the latest toys including classic brands you know and love like Disney, Lego, Star Wars and , and amazing new stuff from the likes of Teletubbies, Caillou, Minecraft and more!

The Teletubbies  are four characters who live in the grassy, lovely place known as Teletubbyland. The Teletubbies love to play in Teletubbyland. They live in a dome well known as the Tubbytronic Superdome. The Teletubbies include the following:

Tinky-Winky, the purple, biggest, gentle Teletubby.
Dipsy, the green, second-biggest, stylish Teletubby.
Laa-Laa, the yellow, third-smallest, bubbly Teletubby.
Po, the red, second-smallest, friendliest Teletubby.
The Tiddlytubbies, the smallest, cute baby Teletubbies.
The Noo Noo, the blue (new series: pink, gold and orange) Teletubby/ vacuum cleaner.
